#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits.h>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
    private:
        FILE *stream;
        char buf[1024];
        int curChar;
        int numChars;
        bool (*filter)(int);

    public:
        InputReader(FILE *stream) {
            this->stream = stream;
        }

        bool isWhitespace(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == EOF;
        }

        int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) {
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            }
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stream);
                } catch (exception &e) {
                    throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
                }
                if (numChars <= 0) {
                    return EOF;
                }
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
                c = read();
            }
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sgn = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                    throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
                }
                res *= 10;
                res += c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
            return res * sgn;
        }

        bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
            if (filter != nullptr) {
                return filter(c);
            }
            return isWhitespace(c);
        }

        void setFilter(bool (*filter)(int)) {
            this->filter = filter;
        }
};

class OutputWriter {
    private:
        FILE *writer;

    public:
        OutputWriter(FILE *writer) {
            this->writer = writer;
        }

        void close() {
            fclose(writer);
        }

        void println(long i) {
            fprintf(writer, "%ld\n", i);
        }
};

class HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching {
    int m;
    int n;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    int *pairU;
    int *pairV;
    int *dis;
    int inf = INT_MAX;
    int NIL = 0;

    public:
        HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching(int m, int n, vector<vector<int>> &g) {
            this->m = m;
            this->n = n;
            this->g = g;
            this->pairU = new int[m + 1];
            this->pairV = new int[n + 1];
            this->dis = new int[m + 1];
        }

        int maximumMatching() {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                pairU[i] = NIL;
                pairV[i] = NIL;
            }

            int maxMatching = 0;

            while (bfs()) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                    if (pairU[i] == NIL && dfs(i))
                        maxMatching++;
                }
            }

            return maxMatching;
        }

        bool bfs() {
            deque<int> queue;

            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                if (pairU[i] == NIL) {
                    queue.push_back(i);
                    dis[i] = 0;
                } else {
                    dis[i] = inf;
                }
            }

            dis[NIL] = inf;

            while (!queue.empty()) {
                int u = queue.front();
                queue.pop_front();

                if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                    for (int v : g[u]) {
                        if (dis[pairV[v]] == inf) {
                            queue.push_back(pairV[v]);
                            dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return dis[NIL] < inf;
        }

        bool dfs(int u) {
            if (u != NIL) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 2) {
                        if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                            pairV[v] = u;
                            pairU[u] = v;
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                dis[u] = inf;
                return false;
            } else
                return true;
        }
};

int main() {
    FILE *inputStream = stdin;
    FILE *outputStream = stdout;
    InputReader in(inputStream);
    OutputWriter out(outputStream);

    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();

    long ans = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
        long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
        ans += nq * 6 * m;
        n = 100 + nn;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
        long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
        ans += mq * 6 * n;
        m = 100 + nm;
    }

    int mat[n + 1][m + 1];

    int u = 1;
    int v = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                mat[i][j] = u;
                u++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                mat[i][j] = v;
                v++;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> g(u);

    for (int i = 0; i < u; i++) {
        g[i].clear();
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 3, j);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i, j - 3);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i, j + 3);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 3, j);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching bpm(u - 1, v - 1, g);

    ans += 2 * bpm.maximumMatching();

    out.println(ans);

    out.close();

    return 0;
}

void addEdge(int mat[n + 1][m + 1], vector<vector<int>> &g, int i, int j, int s, int t) {
    if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m)
        return;

    g[mat[i][j]].push_back(mat[s][t]);
}
